How CAPJI Net talks to your router

Your phone only controls what the router itself exposes (REST API / ubus / web session). Android can discover devices on the LAN, but it cannot block or throttle other devices on its own - the router must enforce the rules.
Demo router: every number is simulated (usage runs ~10x faster so quotas fill quickly).
On real routers without native quota support, caps are counted by CAPJI Net and only enforced while the app/service runs.
Devices with private (randomized) MACs can reappear as new devices and escape MAC-based rules.
Live per-device speed is read from the device\'s queue; devices without a queue show 0.
Quota isn\'t available on this driver. Timed pause is done by the router itself (it removes the block automatically).
Rules are keyed by IP: a changed DHCP lease or a randomized MAC can bypass them.

Username and password are usually on the sticker under the router (e.g. admin / admin). Huawei fibre: telecomadmin or root. Wrong passwords can lock some routers, so type carefully.
Timed pause is done by the app: it blocks the device and unblocks it when time is up. Keep the app open, or unblock manually.
This modem\'s firmware doesn\'t expose per-device speed limits. Use block or timed pause instead.
This modem doesn\'t report per-device data usage, so data quotas aren\'t available. Timed pause and block still work.
Blocking uses the router\'s Wi-Fi MAC filter, so it works for Wi-Fi devices only (not cables).
Huawei locks the login after a few wrong passwords - check the password before retrying.
Blocking is experimental on this firmware. The app reads the rule back from the router and tells you if it was not accepted.

What works on a phone hotspot

Android does not let normal apps block or throttle hotspot clients - that is reserved for the system (or root). This app can: show your phone\'s live traffic, try to list connected devices, and open the system screens where YOU can block devices and set a data limit. Blocking and speed control per device are only possible on a home modem/router with an admin login.
Copies what the app sent/received (no passwords) so a driver can be fixed for your exact model.

Opens your router\'s own admin page inside the app with auto-login and helpers to reach the MAC filter and fill the device\'s MAC. Works with any brand.
